name: The Pulse
fieldReading: Find the beat beneath the beat.
bio: Keeps the same steady time from dusk to dawn, and everyone finds the beat by it.
sceneStory: Sitting cross-legged at the exact center of a vast, glass-still black lake, a figure brings one open hand down onto the water. A single ring of light springs from the strike and races outward across the whole mirrored surface toward the horizon.
assignments: You are not the noise; you are the beat
beneath it, and it holds because you do.
tagline: One strike and the night keeps time
